result.instructions: Tools for Snipe-IT, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which assets are checked out to Sam Ortiz right now?"; "Find the laptop with serial number C02XYZ and show its status."; "List the software licenses that are almost out of seats.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Snipe-IT data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run snipeit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run snipeit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run snipeit_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. snipeit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: snipeit_get_me
tools.title: Get the connected user
tools.description: Get the Snipe-IT user this connection acts as: name, username, department, location and permissions. Good first call to confirm the connection. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: snipeit_list_hardware
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List assets (hardware), with status, model, location and assignment. Filter by model, category, location, company, status or assignee. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/hardware.

search.description: Free-text search across the main fields.

model_id.description: Only assets of this model id.

category_id.description: Only assets in this category id.

location_id.description: Only assets at this location id.

company_id.description: Only assets of this company id.

status_id.description: Only assets with this status label id.

assigned_to.description: Only assets assigned to this id (with assigned_type).

limit.description: Results per call (1 to 100). Snipe-IT's own default applies when omitted.

sort.description: Field to sort by, for example name or created_at.

tools.name: snipeit_get_hardware
tools.title: Get an asset
tools.description: Get one asset by its numeric id: asset tag, serial, model, status, assignment, custom fields and checkout history. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/hardware/{id}.

hardware_id.description: The numeric Snipe-IT id (not the asset tag).

tools.name: snipeit_find_hardware_by_tag
tools.title: Find an asset by asset tag
tools.description: Find one asset by its asset tag, for example ASSET-0001. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/hardware/bytag/{asset_tag}.

asset_tag.description: The asset tag exactly as printed on the asset.

annotations.title: Find an asset by asset tag

tools.name: snipeit_find_hardware_by_serial
tools.title: Find an asset by serial number
tools.description: Find one asset by its serial number. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/hardware/byserial/{serial}.

serial.description: The serial number exactly as recorded.

annotations.title: Find an asset by serial number

tools.name: snipeit_list_overdue_audits
tools.title: List overdue asset audits
tools.description: List assets whose physical audit is overdue. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/hardware/audit/overdue.

department_id.description: Only users of this department id.

location_id.description: Only users at this location id.

limit.description: Results per call (1 to 100). Snipe-IT's own default applies when omitted.

tools.name: snipeit_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by numeric id, with department, location, groups and permissions. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/users/{id}.

tools.name: snipeit_list_user_assets

tools.name: snipeit_checkout_hardware
tools.title: Check out an asset
tools.description: Check an asset out to a user, another asset or a location. Changes who holds the asset and sets its status label. Snipe-IT API: POST /api/v1/hardware/{id}/checkout.

hardware_id.description: The numeric Snipe-IT id (not the asset tag).

status_id.description: Status label id the asset gets while checked out (from snipeit_list_status_labels).

name.description: Name of the checkout, for the record.

tools.name: snipeit_checkin_hardware
tools.title: Check in an asset
tools.description: Check an asset back in: it leaves its holder and gets the status label you give. Snipe-IT API: POST /api/v1/hardware/{id}/checkin.

hardware_id.description: The numeric Snipe-IT id (not the asset tag).

status_id.description: Status label id the asset gets after check-in (from snipeit_list_status_labels).

location_id.description: Location id where the asset is returned.

name.description: Name of the check-in, for the record.
